study: OGI-013-VALIDATION-1 (small prospective cohort: FIXED single model vs equal-resource control vs FruitStack organisation)
status: AUTHORISED by the owner's written order of 2026-10-29 (max 3 tasks, zero cash, existing ceilings); executable only with an approval file for exactly this file
max_tokens_per_step_definition: owner-approved ceiling for ONE agent step (input + the whole answer incl. PlumMe continuations), enforced by PlumMe's ParentBudget before every provider request of the step
dispatch_definition: actual provider REQUESTS: each receipt counts receipt.metadata.provider_attempt_count (continuations, retries, credential rotation), at least 1; rejected attempts count; simulator receipts are the same rows and are not counted twice
token_definition: recorded input+output usage; a successful dispatch without usage halts; a failure rejected before processing (PlumMe REJECTION_CLASSES) is known zero; any other failure without usage is charged reserve_tokens_per_dispatch; tokens of a failed step already carried by its receipts are not charged again
cash_definition: authorised cash is 0.00 USD. Route classes ANONYMOUS_FREE, FREE_TIER, LOCAL, TRIAL_CREDIT, INCLUDED are zero-cash (TRIAL_CREDIT / INCLUDED consume an entitlement, reported); any other or unknown route class without a recorded cost halts.
supply: the full eligible PlumMe supply (budget-aware AUTO), no vendor restriction
halt_policy: a campaign-level limit halts the campaign (exit 3, evidence kept); an episode-level cap ends that episode as BUDGET_STOP (scored non-success) and the campaign continues; no automatic restart of a halted campaign
